title: The Rate Restored Certificate of Deposit Interest Is Worked Out At
content:
Where the deposit that restores a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line carries interest on the loss, the rate that interest is worked out at is graded by the card the owner holds and by what has been charged to it.

## 1. The grades

The rate that interest is worked out at is graded: an owner holding an active Cash Rewards Visa or Travel Rewards Visa Signature card with at least 800.00 USD of card purchases posted in the three months before the deposit earns it at the rate the certificate carries; an owner holding an active card of any tier with less than 800.00 USD of card purchases posted in those three months earns it at the tier's published standard interest rate; every other owner, whatever card they hold and whatever they have charged to it, earns it at the tier's published standard interest rate less the tier's relationship bonus points.

## 2. What is read

The card is an active account of the bank's Personal Credit Cards line belonging to the owner, and the sum counted is what has been charged to it in purchases over the three months ending on the day of the deposit. The figure of 800.00 USD is a floor: exactly 800.00 USD charged in those three months satisfies it.

## 3. Condition and result

| Active card held | Charged to it in those three months | Rate the interest is worked out at |
|---|---|---|
| Cash Rewards Visa or Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 800.00 USD or more | the rate the certificate carries |
| a card of any other tier | 800.00 USD or more | the tier's published standard interest rate, less the tier's relationship bonus points |
| any tier, including the two named | less than 800.00 USD | the tier's published standard interest rate |
| none held | — | the tier's published standard interest rate, less the tier's relationship bonus points |

The second and fourth rows fall to the same grade, that grade taking in every owner the first two do not.

## 4. Worked readings, on hypothetical figures

A certificate carrying 4.12 percent on a tier publishing a standard interest rate of 3.97 percent and relationship bonus points of 0.15.

| The owner's card and spending | Rate |
|---|---|
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature, 1240.00 USD charged | 4.12 percent |
| Cash Rewards Visa, 310.00 USD charged | 3.97 percent |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa, 90.00 USD charged | 3.97 percent |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa, 2600.00 USD charged | 3.82 percent, being 3.97 less 0.15 |
| none held | 3.82 percent |

The fourth row shows that a card of another tier does not reach the first grade however much is charged to it; it is only the smaller-spending grade that takes cards of every tier.
